channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Canada, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Canada, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grant - week of 06 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Inside Out RE:Focus Fund Post-Production Grants 2026
    https://insideout.ca/initiatives/re-focus-fund/
    Inside Out (Toronto 2SLGBTQ+ Film Festival) · deadline Closed 22 Jul 2026 · Post-production grant funding to support the completion and promotion of short and feature films; the requested amount is set by the applicant (see the FAQ 'How much funding can I request?'). Since 2018 the RE:Focus Fund has distributed more than CAD 300,000 in grants and programs. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grant - week of 29 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Call to Artists: Walden Fire Station and Library (Calgary Arts Development)
    https://calgaryartsdevelopment.com/public-art/opportunities/all/call-to-artists-walden-fire-station-and-library/
    Calgary Arts Development (CADA) · deadline Closed 28 Jul 2026 · Total project budget of CAD 275,000 (exclusive of all applicable taxes) for one selected artist/artist team. The artist fee for the total project is CAD 68,750 + GST. Budget breakdown can be adapted to the artist's approach, following CARFAC's recommendation that a minimum 20% of the budget go to the artist's fee; the total allocated budget will not be increased.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 3 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 18 May 2026
item.description:
• Grantham Foundation: Creation Residency in Visual Arts 2026 (Quebec)
    https://www.fondationgrantham.org/en/creation-residency-in-visual-arts
    Fondation Grantham pour l'art et l'environnement · deadline Closed 27 May 2026 · CAD $5,000 to $10,000 grant plus a four-week residency (accommodation and studio provided). No application fee.
  • BC Arts Council: Individual Arts Grants - Media Artists 2026
    https://www.bcartscouncil.ca/program/media-artists/
    BC Arts Council (Province of British Columbia) · deadline Closed 17 Jun 2026 · Up to $25,000 CAD per project. No application fee.
  • Toronto Arts Council: Media Artists Program - Creation 2026
    https://torontoartscouncil.org/grants/media-artists-program-creation/
    Toronto Arts Council · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Up to $15,000 (CAD) per artist for media-arts creation. No application fee.
